notes.title: v1.11
notes.content:
New Content & Changes

 Added 6 new cards to the card pool
 Limited equipment: only 1 weapon can be equipped
 Panel Deck: rebuilt page foundation
 Panel Card Pick: rebuilt page foundation
 Panel Base: improved new card opening effect
 Disabled Panel Update
 Certain cards can now target non-enemy cards


Fixes

 Fixed issue where surrendering missions caused multiple sound effects
 Fixed bug where dropping the last card in the upgrade panel disabled further clicks
 Fixed tutorial misclick triggers causing errors

notes.title: v1.1
notes.content:
Update Notes

New Content

 Added 2 extra missions
 New "Extra Mission" panel added
 Improved root menu card background visuals


Card Reworks

 Wei Hua Li
 Henry Maxwell
 Safe Passage
 Aaliyah Jones


Fixes & Improvements

 Updated patch system to prevent missing mission data
 Fixed an issue where Koyuki Yoshimi could still attack her brother
 Fixed tutorial trigger-related bugs
 Fixed interrupt cards not functioning correctly

notes.title: v1.09
notes.content:
Panel – Fight (Battle UI Enhancements):

 Added visual effect when player HP drops below a certain threshold
 Added visual effect when deck count is low
 Added effect during mission setup if a special condition is present
 Improved clarity when discarding upgrade cards
 Slightly adjusted positions for enemy-related UI elements


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed a logic issue caused by triggering an enemy attack during the player's turn
 Fixed an issue where mission setup animation images might not display properly
 Fixed a bug where tooltips didn’t show when hovering over cards with the mouse
 Fixed a rare case where clicking a target that was already removed caused issues
 Fixed an error when a counterattack with a passive skill kills an enemy
 Fixed an issue where discarding a conditional encounter card could replace it with the wrong one
 Fixed a bug where the final mission used incorrect encounter cards
 Adjusted difficulty for Hunt Missions
 Game now autosaves after completing any run

notes.title: v1.08 Hotfix
notes.content:
Update Notes

 Character Switch Panel: Added "Weakness" title display
 Fixed a bug where gamepad shortcut keys did not work properly in the pregame panel
 Fixed an issue where certain encounter card effects failed to trigger correctly
 Fixed an error that could occur when entering the police station

notes.title: v1.07
notes.content:
Update Notes


 You can now close the upgrade panel using the ESC key or the Cancel button
 Fixed an error triggered when dragging a used player card
 Fixed an issue where the card selection panel could sometimes block interactions
 Encounter deck now shuffles normally and no longer increases the danger level
 Fixed shortcut key movement issue where mission cards and player cards were not linked correctly
 Fixed a bug where a new story voice line could play before the previous one finished
 Fixed an issue where visual effects did not display correctly when adjusting values during setup

notes.title: Hotfix 1.06
notes.content: Fixed an issue where drawing an Encounter card outside of the event phase could cause the screen to freeze

notes.title: v1.05
notes.content:
Free Mode: Added countdown timer that gradually increases difficulty
 Added animation and effects when setting up missions
 Character Switch Panel
 Pregame Panel
 Fight Panel (adjusted timing so it starts after loading, and slightly tweaked some text positions and colors)
 Changed double-click function to right mouse button click
 Improved smoothness of card movement animations
 Slightly adjusted on-screen explanations when entering game scenes
 Added visual effect when switching character modes during combat
 Fixed an issue where placing an ally could sometimes cause the game to freeze
 Fixed a bug where support cards on the field would occasionally highlight invalid targets
 Fixed a problem where switching modes did not remove previous status effects on some characters
 Fixed mouse click issues not registering properly in certain cases

notes.title: version 1.04
notes.content:
Update Notes


 Fixed an issue where voice lines were always incorrect
 Fixed a bug where some buttons played sound effects twice
 Fixed a problem where closing the panel could cause step guidelines to overlap
 Fixed a bug where opening the bag would trigger multiple sound effects
 Switching languages no longer reloads the entire scene
 Improved core code structure for better overall performance and maintainability

notes.title: version 1.03
notes.content:

 Fixed an issue where press actions could still trigger while dragging
 Slightly adjusted mission target values for all locations before they are unlocked
 Fixed a bug where character cards could sometimes point to the wrong ID
 Fixed a tutorial issue where incorrect character information was shown if the player didn’t choose the default character

notes.title: version 1.021
notes.content:
Update Notes


 Slightly reduced the size of the button bag
 Adjusted the position of the ally/support max label
 Fixed an issue where the tutorial could freeze
 Fixed a bug where Mia Martinez’s action skill did not function correctly
 Fixed an issue allowing characters to use actions even with zero stamina
 Fixed a bug where, after using an equipment card, hand cards sometimes couldn’t be selected
 Fixed certain condition cards not working as intended
 Fixed an issue where the main character could still attack with zero stamina
 Fixed Sedative being usable even when the character was not in "used" mode

notes.title: 🧟 Deadwalker Chronicles is Now Live!
notes.content:
Hello, and welcome to a strategic survival trial in a collapsing world.

We're a very small indie team, and Deadwalker Chronicles is our first attempt at blending single-player deckbuilding, survival, and mission-driven gameplay.

In this game, you will:


 Build your deck to face ever-changing missions, crises, and enemies
 Switch between Exploration Mode and Stealth Mode to survive smarter
 Make tough decisions with limited resources as the world around you falls apart


🔧 Currently in Early Access, you can already experience the full core gameplay:


 Dynamic encounter system combining Mission, Zombie, Danger, and Location decks
 Six card types with strategic synergy (Action, Energy, Companion, Equipment, etc.)
 A dual-mode system that adds tactical depth to every situation


🎯 If you're ready to dive in:
▶ Play through a full mission and feel the pressure
▶ Found any thoughts, feedback, or bugs? Let us know in the comments or join our Discord!
▶ If you enjoy the game, please consider leaving a review on Steam — every one of them means a lot to our small team.

📣 Join Our Discord
We’ve also opened a bilingual (English & Chinese) developer Discord community.
Share your feedback, screenshots, thoughts — or just drop by for a chat.

🎧 Discord Link:
👉 Black Phoenix Studio Official Discord

Thank you again for reading,
and may you walk farther than yesterday in this land of the dead.
